method: Saved initial screen, measured before the user requested baseline reuse. Fresh owned portable profiles; same H2641080p30 AAC stereo fixture and actual 1280x720 video canvas at 96 DPI. One measured launch per variant, no discarded warmups, ~30-second windows after at least ten seconds media time. Both Aperture builds use retained-resource production-form native DLL 0e7eec06 and balanced Lanczos-up/Hermite-down/correct-downscaling, bilinear chroma, no linear-light/sigmoid passes. VLC requests D3D11 output, D3D11VA and linear scaling. Different profiles and non-identical output pixels are explicit. Advancing playback/canvas verified for all three saved screen runs. This single-run screen does not establish stable player rankings. No concurrent builders, profilers or other tests. CPU estimate uses raw process cycles divided by actual elapsed time and a validated invariant-TSC calibration on this same CPU/boot, as percent of one logical processor; sampled process CPU times retained separately. RAM is median private commit of seven snapshots per run. Memory categories overlap and cannot be summed.

research.precisionDecision: Not adopted. RGB10 changes pixels; HDR screenshots differed despite both selecting float. HDR quality equivalence remains unproven.
research.directNv12: Opt-in isolated prototype keeps existing separable LUT weights and directly reconstructs NV12. First active fixed H264 capture max difference 1/255 per channel, PSNR64.86dB; single engine screen ~30MiB lower private RAM. Not a repeated full-player result or proof across formats. Guarded HDR/alpha/rotation/crop cases fall back. App source does not enable it.
research.failedScreens: First native C compile failed on a macro comma; fixed. First built direct screen failed actual-path assertion due an overly strict identity-swizzle guard; preserved. v3 comparator completed both paths, but the surrounding shell incorrectly treated unset LASTEXITCODE as failure. Raw per-process checks and results are retained.

limits: One synthetic full-app fixture; broad-format/overall win remains unproven.
App builds include pre-existing dirty source edits; observations do not isolate every contribution.

Only the initial n1 screen is summarized numerically. The subsequent repeated app/VLC batch was interrupted at the user request; its completed raw runs are preserved without aggregation. Future comparisons reuse the saved matching VLC baseline and defer visible playback checks.

Live driver v1 assumed Stop retained the queue; v2 rejected legitimate mouse-triggered reallocations. Corrected v3 uses explicit Open and tolerates visible controls while requiring actual idle retirement. Earlier partial traces retained.
Lower-precision and direct-filter native prototypes are not production app defaults.
Native direct capture is one fixture/window size; more quality and fallback checks required before adoption.
